acceptance_criteria.text: Given frontend/review.html as shipped, when the outgoing POST /audio/preview body is derived from the ttsPlay function source, then the provider value is the identifier the page already tracks and keys its cache on (ttsProvider), and is not a string literal of any kind.

Given a workbench with a valid OPENAI_API_KEY, when a human clicks Play on a beat or a tour-preview stop, then the request carries the dropdown's current value, the response is 200 audio/mpeg, and the button never enters its error state.

Given a request naming a provider the server cannot resolve, then the server answers 400 and the page surfaces a visible error. It must NOT return 200, must NOT return audio/wav, and must NOT substitute a different provider.

Given every Pydantic request model under src/api/models/ that has a provider field, when its default is read, then that default is either None or a name get_provider() resolves against _PROVIDERS. No model default may name an unregistered or non-serving implementation.

Given the app omits provider and voice_id, when it calls the audio routes, then the server resolves the provider from the TTS_PROVIDER pin exactly as today, and this holds whether the app sends a null body or a partial body such as {'voice_id': ...}.

Given POST /audio/preview, when more than the configured limit of requests arrive inside the window for ANY provider name the server can resolve, then the guard returns 429. No provider name may skip it, and the guard must not depend on another module's registry contents.

Given the workbench onboarding page drives POST /onboard/jobs/{id}/draft-beats with confirm_cost, when the drafter is resolved, then it is the real drafter, and the model named in the 409 cost estimate is the model that actually ran.
Given the drafter pin is unset, when draft-beats is called with confirm_cost true, then it returns a non-2xx naming the missing pin. It must NOT return 200 with mock-drafted beats.

Given build_full_verifier called with faithfulness_checker=None, when it runs, then it does not silently produce a report that reads as verified — per Decision A it raises, and scripts/tour_build.py reports faithfulness explicitly as NOT CHECKED.
Given mobile/lib, when its source is walked structurally, then no product code path names or resolves a test double, and the guard goes RED if one is introduced.

Given a server process, when a non-serving implementation is sought through an environment variable, a config profile, a request-body field, a deploy manifest, or a default argument, then none of them can reach one. In-process registration remains the only door and has zero callers under src/ and scripts/.
Given each new guard, when its corresponding fix is reverted one at a time, then the named test goes RED with the output pasted. A guard that cannot be turned red does not exist.

Given every doc comment and docstring touched by this work, when it is read against the shipped code, then none contradicts it — specifically the guard docstring claiming mock stays in the dropdown, and the mock-era comments in src/api/routes/audio.py.
Given the whole change set, when make lint runs, then it reports zero errors, and the hermetic suite still runs offline at $0 with the doubles importable and used by tests/.
